alternatives_and_negative_results: Post-hoc threshold relaxation, relabeling the old result PASS, or silently substituting a method after observing final data are invalid.
applicability: Statistical-method or numerical-contract revisions under formal change control.
assessed_root_cause: The failed result was a method-coverage failure, not a failed radar detection performance trial.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Retain the failed version and its evidence; use formal engineer-approved prospective amendment, independent calibration and fixed qualification before any main experiment.
generalizable_lesson: When a qualification method fails, preserve the failure and make any replacement prospective, versioned and independently qualified.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: A method failure could be mistaken for a reason to delete the old result or retrospectively relax acceptance limits.
non_applicability: Does not imply that a later method automatically validates every application domain; transfer must be separately demonstrated.
observable_consequence: The original 7/15 failure remains preserved; only a prospectively approved S02 v1.1 amendment and later v1.2 method were qualified under new frozen protocols.
observed_problem: The original Student-t CPI-interval method failed its prespecified 15-condition coverage qualification (8/15 pass, 7/15 fail).
repeatable_validation: Verify original 7/15 record, independent v1.1 15/15 qualification and approved v1.2 contract/result as separate immutable artifacts.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: No approved baseline or historical FAIL may be rewritten; preserve old hashes and approval scope.
title: Preserve failed qualification evidence when replacing a statistical method
